# Site commands: info

## `fptctl info`

Show the server's version and capabilities.

Prints what the library's info returns: the server version and the features it supports. It reads no entity data, so it is a quick check that a site answers.

```text
fptctl info [OPTIONS]
```

Library call: `Shotgun.info`.

Examples:

```shell
fptctl info
fptctl --site https://studio.shotgrid.autodesk.com info
```
